title: LLM-PowerTrace: A Dataset of Time-Resolved GPU Power Traces for AI Compute
abstract: arXiv:2610.38315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and difficult to model. We introduce LLM-PowerTrace, an open dataset of time-resolved, per-GPU power traces for LLM fine-tuning and inference, sampled every 100\,ms on varying NVIDIA platforms paired with complete workload and system metadata. translated_title: LLM-PowerTrace：面向AI计算的时间分辨GPU功耗轨迹数据集
translated_abstract: AI计算正在成为规模庞大且快速变化的电力负载。其对数据中心基础设施和电网的影响不仅取决于总能耗，还取决于其功率在亚秒到分钟时间尺度上的变化方式，包括峰值、功率爬坡以及多个加速器之间的同步波动。现有的大语言模型（LLM）能耗基准通常只报告每token焦耳数等汇总性指标，很少发布底层的时间序列测量数据，导致这些功率动态特性难以被充分刻画和建模。我们推出了LLM-PowerTrace，这是一个开放数据集，包含针对LLM微调和推理的时间分辨、逐GPU功耗轨迹，每100毫秒采样一次，覆盖多种NVIDIA平台，并配有完整的工作负载和系统元数据。在微调方面，LLM-PowerTrace对涵盖多种模型规模和微调方法的开放模型家族进行了剖析，并对批次大小等参数进行了受控扫描……（原文摘要不完整，此处为可获取部分的翻译）
tldr: 提出了LLM-PowerTrace，一个以100毫秒为采样间隔、覆盖LLM微调与推理的开放式逐GPU时间分辨功耗轨迹数据集，填补了AI计算功率动态特性（峰值、爬坡、同步波动）数据缺失的空白。
en_tdlr: LLM-PowerTrace is an open dataset of time-resolved, per-GPU power traces sampled every 100ms for LLM fine-tuning and inference, enabling characterization and modeling of AI compute's power dynamics beyond aggregate energy metrics.
